item.title: Cirigliano. History, stories, people
item.description: This book is a tribute to Cirigliano, its history, and its community. Born from the patient and passionate research of Giuseppe Urgo, later continued and completed by his son Dino and his grandson Marcello, it reconstructs the historical memory of a village—its places, families, traditions, documents, and images that tell the story of its evolution over time. At a time when many small towns are experiencing steady depopulation and collective memory is at risk of fading, these pages seek to preserve and pass on a heritage of history, identity, and belonging.

item.title: Corrado Urgo
item.description: Born in Cirigliano in 1949, he moved with his family to Matera in 1956 and continues to live there. Although he now visits Cirigliano mainly during the summer or for short stays, he continues to think of himself as a Ciriglianese, preserving vivid memories of its people and customs, as well as a close familiarity with the local dialect.
